narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to entertain the audience through a series of lighthearted pranks using a trick water gun that shoots backwards. It leverages the genuine reactions of colleagues and the high-energy persona of the creator to create a comedic, viral-style montage.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator identifies the product as '新入手的古靈精怪槍' (a newly acquired prank gun) and spends the entire video demonstrating its unique function and use-case.
